AccountId.title: AccountId
AccountId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the customer account used to retrieve the support ticket.

ActionMessage.title: ActionMessage
ActionMessage.description: Displays the final message indicating ticket priority and actions taken by the system.

AssignedAgent.title: AssignedAgent
AssignedAgent.description: Indicates the support agent or team assigned to handle the ticket.

PriorityLevel.title: PriorityLevel
PriorityLevel.description: Represents the calculated ticket priority level (High, Medium, Low) based on issue description.

TicketId.title: TicketId
TicketId.description: Returns the unique identifier of the support ticket analyzed by the system.
